message:
feat: TensorFold 0.3.4, every model on the lanes (work-in-progress snapshot) (#15)

- Nemotron and Flash Next run on the lane engine (family rounds); the serial
  engine is gone. Every drafted round verifies 2+ rows; replies report
  min_rows and token_sha.
- Nemotron: row-exact kernels on Macs without tensor units (it now drafts on
  M1 to M4), TensorFold's own verify matmuls on the M5, MTP drafts over a
  32,768-id list built from recorded public text.
- Flash Next: MTP drafts over its 79,592-id list, chained drafts on the GPU.
- Nemotron and Flash Next prompts go through the row-exact decode kernels, so
  resumed prompts equal fresh ones.
- Qwen3.8-27B on M1 to M4: a lane decoder without tensor units
  (kernels/qwen/dense/v1/row_forward.py) and a row-exact simdgroup matmul
  (simd_qmm.py). M3 Ultra 141.3 / 73.9 / 158.4 / 74.2 tok/s against MLX
  serial 38-39. Prompts resume from a 2,048-token grid (exact, MLX's speed).
  Tool requests draft as many tokens as pay.
- CUDA: no default path decodes one token a round. The 27B needs DFlash2 and
  Flash Next its MTP head (or --no-drafts); GLM drafts with DFlash2 when MTP
  is off or missing.
- Version 0.3.4.
